lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: You're listening to Void Beats. Lo-fi for staring into the void. The void is also studying.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Void Beats. Eighty-eight point four. Somewhere underneath everything else.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: This is Void Beats, from Room Zero. There's no door. So, I suppose, you're already in.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Void Beats. It's late. The void's still up. So are you. Hi.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Morning. This is Void Beats. The void doesn't really do mornings. Neither do I. And yet, here we all are.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: You're tuned to Void Beats. Please don't tap on the void. It's trying to concentrate.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Void Beats.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That was the void. It says hi.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That was... I want to say a song. It was definitely a song. I was going to tell you what it was called, and then a planet drifted past the window, and I just...

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: ...watched it. For a while. Anyway. Here's another one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Quick update on the void. It has not done the dishes. It has, however, borrowed my good mug, and I can see it from here, on the far side of the ceiling, being used as a small moon.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That's fine. I have other mugs. Here's something warm.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: So, I was thinking. About... you know when you... and then the...

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Okay, it's gone. It was a really good thought. Possibly the best one I've ever had. Here's a song about it.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Morning. Or the bit after night where it's still night, but with intentions. Put the kettle on.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The void put the kettle on four hours ago. It still hasn't boiled. We're starting to think the void is the kettle. Here's a song.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Study tip from Room Zero. Read the same page eleven times. On the twelfth time, the page reads you. That's when you know you're ready.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That's not a good tip. Please don't take tips from me. Here's a better song.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The thing asleep on my notes is, we think, a cat. It has the general shape of a cat. It purrs at the frequency of distant stars, which I'm told is not standard.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It's very warm. I'm not moving it. I'm not moving anything, ever again. Here's the next one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: This hour of Void Beats comes to you from Grumbel's Ladders. I asked them if they make a ladder that goes down. They said, every ladder goes down, if you believe in yourself.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Then they hung up. Grumbel's Ladders. Up is a choice. I'm choosing to stay down here. It's cozy.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Evening, everyone. The sun went down a while ago. Down where, nobody knows. Probably here. A lot of things end up here. Make yourself comfortable. Here's a slow one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Can't sleep? Me neither. I asked the void earlier if it ever sleeps.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It's never answered before. Okay. Okay. Here's a song. A loud one. No, a quiet one. Let's do a quiet one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Someone wrote in to ask if the void gets lonely. So I asked it. It didn't say anything. But later, I found it had made two cups of tea.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: So I think it's alright. I think it's alright.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Coming up, more beats for being a small creature in a very big room. Which is all of us. Even the void. Especially the void. It's enormous, and it still has to do the dishes. Eventually.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Afternoon check-in. How's the work going? Mine's going great. I've written my name at the top. In bubble letters. It took most of the morning.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Here's something to keep you company while you do yours.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That last one was recorded in a desk drawer, by someone very small, very patiently. You could hear the drawer in the low end. Lovely drawer. Here's a song from a much bigger drawer.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: If you've lost a shadow, one went past the window about an hour ago. Smallish. Carrying a hat. Answers to Greg, apparently.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Hollis, if he's yours... he looked happy. Just so you know. Here's the next one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It's very late, which is the best time to be a little bit sad and a little bit cozy at the same time. Like soup. Here's a song that's like soup.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: I was going to read out a listener message, but I've lost it. It's in the void. Everything I lose ends up in the void. My keys. My lunch. A whole Thursday, once.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The void says hello. From Thursday.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Quick break. Stand up. Stretch. Drink some water. Look at something far away, to rest your eyes. If you're in Room Zero, everything is far away, so that's easy. Okay. Sit down. Here's a song.

clips.title: Bev is looking for a song

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Oh. We have a caller. Hello, you're on Void Beats.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Hello, love. It's Bev. Is this the request line?

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: There's... sort of only one line. So, yes?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Lovely. I'm trying to find a song. I heard it once, in a lift, in a different dimension. It goes... da da dum. Da da.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Da da dum. Da da.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: That's it! Do you know it?

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: No. But I'm going to be thinking about it for the rest of my life.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: That's what happened to me, love. Thank you. I'll try the next one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: This is the three in the morning hour, on Void Beats. If you're awake, you're in the right place.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: If you're asleep, that's also the right place.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It's three in the morning. The best hour. Nobody wants anything from you at three in the morning. Even the void has gone quiet.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Well. Quieter.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: If you're up because you can't sleep, hi. If you're up because you're working, hi.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: And if a thought woke you up and won't leave, it's not as big as it feels. It's three in the morning. Everything's wearing a bigger coat.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The probably-a-cat has moved from my notes to my lap. So I'm not allowed to get up now. That's the rule.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: I'm here till dawn, then. With you. Here's something soft.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Void Beats.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: She's asleep.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: She's asleep on the desk.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: I put a blanket on her.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Here is a song.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Someone asked if I get lonely.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: I made two cups of tea.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: I did the dishes.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Don't tell her.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Next song.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Study Hall, on Void Beats. Phones face down. Books face up. The void is face, um. It hasn't really got a face. Let's begin.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Study tip. Every forty minutes, stand up, look out of a window, and blink.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: If you're in Room Zero, the window just shows the void, and the void blinks back. That counts. Okay. Back to it.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The void has been reading the same page for an hour. I think it's a hard page. Or a really good one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: I'm not going to ask. Let's both keep going.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That was, yeah. That was one. That was definitely one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Mm. Sorry. I was somewhere else for a bit. I'm back.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Void Beats. Still here. Still mostly awake.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Hey. It's late, and you're still here. Me too.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Update on the void. It still hasn't done the dishes. But it has stacked them, very neatly, in order of size.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: I think that's growth. I'm going to say that's growth.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: People ask about the Late Bus. They're always late. They were late to their own name. By the time they turned up, everyone was already calling them that.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Kettle Boy sent us a note. It just says, the kettle is on. That's all Kettle Boy ever says. It's always true. I find it very reassuring.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: I tried to tidy the desk earlier. I moved one book. Underneath it was a smaller book, and under that, a note from me, from last year.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It said, don't bother. So I didn't.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The thing asleep on my notes has started purring in time with the beat. I don't know if it's listening, or if the beat's listening to it. Either way. Very cozy.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: If you've got something due tomorrow, you've got time. You've got exactly enough time, if you start in about, now.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Or now. Or, okay. Now's fine too.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Anyway. I've lost my thread. Here's another one.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Here's something warm. Hold it with both hands.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Okay. More beats. For the void. And for you.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Here's the next one. I'm going to stare at a planet for a bit.

clips.title: Bev Gets Her Song, Part Seven: The Other Half

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Oh. A caller. Hello, you're on Void Beats.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Hello, love. It's Bev. I rang before, about the song.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Da da dum, da da. I still think about it every day. I was right. It's for life.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: I've only got the first half, love. Stan's half. Everyone says, try the void. They say everything lost ends up in there.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It's true. My keys are in there. A whole Thursday. Okay. Hum your half. I'll hold the phone up to the window.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Dum. Dum. Da dum.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Da da dum.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Da da.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: That was the void. It's never done that before.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: That's it. That's the bit after he cried. I haven't heard that bit since he went.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Sorry, Bev. I'm crying a bit. The probably-a-cat looks concerned.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Does it know what it's called, love?

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Void? What's it called?

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It doesn't know. It just kept it safe. That's sort of what it does.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: That's what Stan did. He never knew what anything was called. He just kept it.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Keep going, Bev. The name's out there somewhere.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Thank you, love. Thank the void for me.

lines.speaker: The Void
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: The void has dressed up for Halloween. It's put a sheet over itself. So now it's a ghost. Or it's a void with a sheet on. It's honestly hard to tell.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: It's very proud. Please don't say anything.

lines.speaker: DJ Eventually
lines.text: Void Beats. Halloween week. The void does this all year, for free.
